post.description:
Referral Submission API provides the ability to Submit Referrals.

The following parameters are required:
- payerId - 87726
- Referring Provider/Requester Details - Name, Address, NPI, MPIN. MPIN is returned in the response of Retrieve Provider Information API (api/graphql/provider/v1.0).
- Referred to Provider Details - Name, Address, National Provider Identifier (NPI),
- Provider Identification Number (MPIN-UHC proprietary field). MPIN is returned in the response of Retrieve Provider Information API (api/graphql/provider/v1.0).
- Patient Information - Patient/Dependent Information
- Subscriber Information - Information of policy holder
- Date Range for the services to be provided
- Diagnosis/Clinical information

The API response will include the below information:
- Referral Status
- Referring Provider Information
- Referred Provider Information
- Referred Patient/Subscriber Information
- Rejection Reasons if any

Rejection reason may be present as below
- AAAN42P : The system is unavailable please try again
- AAAN42Y : Timeout/Backend issue, please try again
- AAAN33C : Please review service date range for the member's policy
- AAAN41N : Please verify the requesting provider details
- AAAN42N : Please review the syntax
- AAAN57C : Please update the service dates and try resubmission
- AAAN95N : Patient is not eligibile, resubmission is not allowed
- AAAY72C : Please verify the member ID and try again
- AAAN78N : Please verify members eligibility, resubmission is not allowed
- AAAN65C : Please verify members Last Name and try again
- AAAN75N : Subscriber/insured not found, please verify details
- AAA:AK9 : Please try again referral submission failed
- AAAN35C : Only PCP can do referral submission for this member, please update the referring provider details
- AAAY95C : Patient is not eligibile, please correct and resubmit
- AAAN49C : Please update the referring provider details to members PCP
- AAAN51C : Referring or referred provider details are not correct, please update and try resubmission
- AAAN51N : Referring or referred provider details are not correct, resubmission not allowed
- AAAN71N : Patient Birth Date Does Not Match our record
- AAAN72C : Please verify the member ID
- AAAN79C : Referring or referred provider details are not correct, please update and try resubmission
- AAAN95C : Patient is not eligibile, please correct and resubmit
- AAANAFC : Please correct the diagnosis code and try again
- AAAY42C : The system is unavailable please try again
- AAAY64C : Please verify the member ID
- AAAY65C : Please verify members Name/DOB and try again
- AAAY71C : Patient Birth Date Does Not Match our record, please update and try again
- AAAY68C : Duplicate records for the member was found, please add more details and resubmit
- AAAY73C : Please verify the member/subscriber name and try again.

This API supports these Payer IDs: 87726, 06111.

post.description:
Referral Status API provides the status information of a previously Submitted Referral.
For the CSP platform, 'referringProviderMpin', 'referredToProviderMpin', and 'denialDescription' will be populated in the response.

The following parameters are required:

- memberId
- patientDob
- patientFn
- firstServiceDt
- lastServiceDt
- payerId - 87726

The API response will include the below information:

- Referral ID
- Referring Provider Information
- Referred Provider Information
- Referred Patient/Subscriber Information

This API supports these Payer IDs: 87726, 06111.

post.description:
This API returns Provider Details based on the TIN and provider last name.

The response body will include:
- Medical Provider Identification Number (MPIN-UHC proprietary field)
- National Provider Identifier (NPI)
- Phone
- First Name and Last Name for the submitted TIN.

The following key information is required:

- MPIN
- NPI

Both of these values are required for Referral Submission, and therefore must be called before submitting a referral via Referral Submission API.

Note: This API should be used for each provider associated with a given referral, and must be called separately to obtain each referring and referred provider.

This API supports these Payer IDs: 87726, 06111, 81400, 37602, 86047.

memberId.description: The member's identification number. MemberId is validated to ensure that it is not blank.

patientDob.description: The member's date of birth. Must be passed in the request in yyyy-MM-dd format. Date of Birth is validated to ensure that it is not blank

firstName.description: The member's first name. First Name is validated to ensure that it is not blank.

firstServiceDt.description: The first date of service. Must be passed in the request in yyyy-MM-dd format. First Date of Service is validated to ensure that it is not blank. Please note that the First Date of Service must be an earlier date than the Last Date of Service.

lastServiceDt.description: The last date of service. Must be passed in the request in yyyy-MM-dd format. Last Date of Service is validated to ensure that it is not blank. Please note that the Last Date of Service must be a later date than the First Date of Service.

payerId.description: The payer's identification number. Payer ID is validated to ensure that it is not blank.

status.description: The desired referral status to search for.

requesterTin.description: The requester's Tax Identification Number.  If Requester TIN is passed in the request, it is validated to ensure that the TIN is not blocked.  If the TIN is blocked, a TIN validation error message will be returned.

patientDob.description: The patient's date of birth.  Must be passed in the request in MM-dd-yyyy format.

referredNpi.description: The referred provider's National Provider Identifier.

serviceStartDt.description: The service start date.  Must be passed in the request in yyyyMMdd format.

serviceEndDt.description: The service end date.  Must be passed in the request in yyyyMMdd format.

referredTin.description: The referred provider's Tax Identification Number. If Referred TIN is passed in the request, it is validated to ensure that the TIN is not blocked. If the TIN is blocked, a TIN validation error message will be returned.
